ideas.pitch: An autonomous agentic workflow manager that monitors local campus server networks and automatically triages and patches security misconfigurations.
ideas.title: AgenticOps Raipur
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Agentic AI and Cybersecurity tracks simultaneously; judges at brief 8-hour hackathons value working agent loops over generic automation.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight blockchain-based verifiable credential issuing and instant verification portal for college project submissions.
ideas.title: BlockTrust Student Credential Layer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the Blockchain theme with a concrete use case tailored for a college fest context (Avesh at CGIT), making it instantly relevant to local judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time network security sniffer that visualizes unauthorized packet anomalies on an interactive web dashboard for campus IT admins.
ideas.title: CampusNet Sentry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Network Security and Web Development tracks with a live, demonstrable working demo showing active packet analysis during the 8-hour window.

ideas.pitch: Edge-optimized computer vision system using lightweight models to detect agricultural crop diseases from low-resolution smartphone captures.
ideas.title: AgriSplat AI Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven computer-vision classification patterns from past winners like CricketVision_AI, tailored for regional utility in Chhattisgarh.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first, low-bandwidth GPS and IoT tracker for intra-campus transport utilizing minimal local hardware nodes.
ideas.title: OpenInnovate Campus Shuttle Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Hardware and Miscellaneous open innovation track with a practical problem faced directly by students attending the CGIT campus.
